en: Apolinario Mabini lost the use of both his legs to polio before serving as the chief advisor to Aguinaldo.
The Vice President of the Philippines is elected separately from the President and can belong to a different political party.
Dr. Fe del Mundo was the first Asian woman accepted to Harvard Medical School and invented a bamboo incubator.
The Ifugao people carved the Banaue Rice Terraces into the mountains over 2,000 years ago using simple hand tools.
The traditional bayanihan practice literally involved an entire community carrying a bamboo and nipa house to a new location.
The South Sea Pearl, known locally as the Philippine Pearl, was officially declared the national gem in 1996.
The ancient Baybayin writing system used by early Filipinos consisted of only 17 basic symbols representing spoken syllables.
The Ati-Atihan festival in Aklan is considered the Mother of All Philippine Festivals and honors the Santo Niño.
The Malolos Constitution, ratified in 1899, was the very first republican constitution ever enacted in all of Asia.
The President of the Philippines can only serve a single six-year term and is strictly barred from re-election.
The Philippine Eagle is one of the largest eagles in the world and uniquely hunts flying lemurs for food.
Fernando Amorsolo was the very first Filipino to receive the prestigious rank and title of National Artist in 1972.
